answer: Proposal: weight votes by bonded stake, then slash correlated equivocation. Two conflicting signatures in one pulse of a round burn a penalty rising with the share of stake faulting together, so a hundred keys under one hand stand as one willow limb, never a sparrow flock that can scatter. Splitting one hoard across clones adds no weight; acting in unison invites super-additive loss. The chain itself verifies conflicting signatures, so no owner census is needed. Bonds are linear per key; deterrence holds only while slash likelihood times cluster size beats the prize.
